_comment: Test files excluded from collection, with the measured reason for each. This list may only SHRINK. scripts/check_test_quarantine.py fails when a NEW file is quarantined, and ALSO fails when a listed file starts passing -- so a fixed file must be deleted from here rather than lingering as permanent amnesty. Same shape as scripts/schema_contract_baseline.json.
_origin: All 16 files were quarantined in one commit on 2026-05-23 (#362, 'working test infrastructure + pre-push hook + CI') -- the same commit that turned the gates ON. Getting a green baseline meant exempting everything that failed, and nothing ever forced a re-check. Re-measured 2026-08-09 against the live database: 5 files passed with no changes at all (35 tests) and were released. Two more were broken BY the quarantining itself; fixing the import order released a SIXTH file (test_conveyancing_integration.py, 8 passed) -- found by the ratchet on its very first run, which is the behaviour this file exists for.
_how_to_clear_an_entry: Fix the test, run scripts/check_test_quarantine.py, and it will tell you the entry is now passing and must be deleted from this file.

entries.error: ValueError: not enough values to unpack (expected 13, got 9)
entries.cause: The function under test gained fields; the test still destructures the old arity. Signature drift, not a broken environment.
entries.note: The most valuable entry here: 50 tests already pass and are switched off with the 27. Splitting the file would release those 50 immediately.

entries.measured: 12 skipped (2026-08-09, after the import-order fix in this PR)
entries.error: Previously SyntaxError: 'from __future__ import annotations' must precede all other statements
entries.cause: THE QUARANTINE COMMIT CAUSED THIS. Inserting 'import pytest / pytestmark = ...' at the top of the file pushed the __future__ import below other statements, which is illegal Python. The file was not broken before it was quarantined. Import order is fixed in this PR; the 12 tests now collect and skip on their own guard conditions.
entries.note: This is the gate that enforces extract -> tag -> verify coverage -> THEN enable an LGA. It not running is how 13 councils with zero provisions reached NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLED_LGAS. Releasing it needs its skip guards reviewed -- it collects, but every test currently skips, and a test that always skips protects nothing.

entries.cause: Depends on a library the project no longer uses. Either the test is obsolete and should be deleted, or the import should be dropped. Not an environment problem -- the dependency is genuinely gone.
The fixture file it loads at import time is not in the repository. Either commit the fixture or make the load lazy and skip when absent.

entries.error: TypeError: Object of type MagicMock is not JSON serializable
entries.cause: A mock is being passed where a serialisable value is expected. Test-side defect, fixable without touching product code.

A script that reads as a test. It calls a live server at http://localhost:3003. Candidate for deletion rather than repair -- it has never been able to run in CI and does not assert anything pytest can see.
